payout_quote: Official petme.social 'Become a Pet Sitter': 'Get paid within 2 business days after each booking. Keep up to 90% of every booking.' Also: 'Payments are processed automatically after each completed booking. Funds are transferred to your bank account within 2 business days. You keep up to 90% of every booking.' And: 'Dog walking typically earns $15 to $30 per walk, while overnight boarding can earn $35 to $75 per night.'
steps: Download the Petme app (iOS/Android) and create your account.
Select 'Become a verified pet sitter', build your profile with photos, bio, services, and your own rates.
Complete identity verification and the pet safety guidelines; submit your application for review.
Once approved, activate your sitter profile and start receiving booking requests from pet owners in your area.
Complete bookings; payments are processed automatically and land in your bank account within 2 business days.
catches: Petme keeps up to 10% of each booking — you keep up to 90%; the exact take-home depends on your set rates.
Earnings are variable with no guaranteed bookings; the $15-$30/walk and $35-$75/night figures are typical ranges, not promises.
Must be 18+, pass identity verification, and complete pet safety guidelines before approval.
You are an independent sitter; earnings depend on location, services, availability, and reviews.
biggest_catch: Variable gig pay with no guaranteed bookings: you set your own rates and keep up to 90% per booking, but the $15-$75 typical per-service figures are not guaranteed and depend entirely on local demand.
eligibility: 18+, pass Petme identity verification, complete pet safety guidelines; available in US, UK, Canada, Australia, and EU markets.
timing: Application review takes days; paid automatically within 2 business days after each completed booking.

c1.evidence: Petme — pet sitting marketplace (200k+ pet parents per the company); official petme.social.

s1.note: 18+, identity verification, pet safety guidelines completion.

s2.note: Variable: sitter sets rates, keeps up to 90%; typical $15-$30/walk, $35-$75/night — real cash, no fixed amount.

notes: Pet sitting/dog walking marketplace distinct from Rover/Wag by its up-to-90% take-home rate. Sitters set their own rates; official page gives typical earnings ($15-$30 per walk, $35-$75 per boarding night) framed as variable, not guaranteed. ID verification required for all sitters.
payout_value_note: Official petme.social typical sitter earnings: $15-$30 per dog walk, $35-$75 per boarding night; sitters keep up to 90% of each booking.
numeric_basis: payout from official typical per-service ranges ($15-$75); time: ~1-4h active care per booking day, variable.
